name: Resolving Conflict
overview: Scripture teaches that resolving conflict requires humility, gentle speech, and a commitment to reconciliation. A soft answer can turn away wrath, while harsh words provoke anger, emphasizing the need for careful communication. Believers are called to be peacemakers, actively seeking to restore relationships by addressing offenses privately and forgiving repentant brothers. Loving enemies and doing good to those who hate us further reflects Christ's call to embody grace in conflict resolution.
